# Job Description - Business Architect

**← Back to [EAP Home](../../../README.md) • [Resources](../../README.md) • [Job Descriptions](../README.md)**

---

> **Position**: Business Architect
> **Department**: Enterprise Architecture Practice
> **Reports To**: Senior Enterprise Architect
> **Location**: Remote/Hybrid
> **Classification**: Full-time

---
page_texts.2:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#position-summary]

## Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Business Architect to join our Enterprise Architecture Practice (EAP) team. This role will design and optimize business processes, capabilities, and organizational structures within Gainwell Technologies' healthcare portfolio, ensuring alignment between business strategy and technology implementation while driving operational excellence and digital transformation.

---
page_texts.4:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#business-architecture-design]

### Business Architecture Design

- Design comprehensive business architecture aligned with organizational strategy and ERA principles
- Develop business capability models, value streams, and process architectures for healthcare operations
- Create business architecture blueprints that guide technology investment and organizational design
- Establish business architecture governance frameworks and standards
page_texts.5:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#process-optimization--design]

### Process Optimization & Design

- Analyze and redesign healthcare business processes for efficiency and effectiveness
- Design process models for Medicaid, CHIP, and other government healthcare programs
- Create business process documentation and workflow designs
- Support business process automation and digital transformation initiatives
page_texts.6:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#stakeholder-engagement--requirements]

### Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements

- Work closely with business stakeholders to understand strategic objectives and operational needs
- Facilitate business architecture workshops and requirements gathering sessions
- Translate business strategy into actionable architecture roadmaps
- Support change management and organizational transformation initiatives
page_texts.7:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#business--technology-alignment]

### Business & Technology Alignment

- Bridge the gap between business strategy and technology implementation
- Collaborate with enterprise architects to ensure technology solutions support business capabilities
- Provide business context and requirements for technology architecture decisions
- Support business case development and technology investment planning
page_texts.8:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#healthcare-domain-expertise]

### Healthcare Domain Expertise

- Design business architectures specific to healthcare and government operations
- Understand healthcare compliance requirements and their impact on business processes
- Support healthcare interoperability and data sharing initiatives from a business perspective
- Design member and provider engagement strategies and processes

---
page_texts.10:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#education]

### Education

- **Minimum**: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Information Systems, or related field
- **Preferred**: Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Healthcare Management, or relevant field
page_texts.11:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#experience]

### Experience

- **Required**: 6+ years of experience in business analysis, process design, or business architecture
- **Required**: 3+ years of experience in healthcare operations or government healthcare programs
- **Preferred**: 4+ years of experience in healthcare technology or Medicaid systems
page_texts.13:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#core-business-architecture]

#### Core Business Architecture

- Business architecture frameworks (BIZBOK, TOGAF Business Architecture)
- Business capability modeling and value stream mapping
- Business process modeling and optimization (BPMN, Lean, Six Sigma)
- Organizational design and change management
page_texts.14:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#healthcare-business-knowledge]

#### Healthcare Business Knowledge

- Healthcare business processes and workflows
- Government healthcare program operations (Medicaid, CHIP, SNAP, TANF)
- Healthcare compliance and regulatory requirements (HIPAA, MITA)
- Healthcare stakeholder management (members, providers, state agencies)
page_texts.15:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#analysis--modeling-tools]

#### Analysis & Modeling Tools

- Business process modeling tools (draw.io, Mermaid, Lucidchart, Bizagi)
- Business architecture tools (MEGA, PowerBI) and architecture-as-code practices
- Data analysis and visualization tools (Excel, Tableau, Power BI)
- Project management and collaboration tools
page_texts.16:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#technology-understanding]

#### Technology Understanding

- Basic understanding of enterprise technology architectures
- Knowledge of healthcare interoperability standards (X12 EDI, NCPDP, FHIR, HL7)
- Understanding of cloud platforms and digital transformation
- Familiarity with data management and analytics concepts
page_texts.17:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#documentation--ai-tools]

#### Documentation & AI Tools

- Markdown and documentation-as-code practices for business architecture documentation
- Experience with AI assistants (ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for analysis and documentation
- Generative AI tools for business process analysis, modeling, and optimization
- AI agents for automating business analysis and workflow documentation tasks
page_texts.20:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#preferred]

#### Preferred

- Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP)
- TOGAF certification with Business Architecture focus
- Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher)
- Healthcare-specific certifications (CHAM, PAHCOM)

---
page_texts.22:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#healthcare-industry-experience]

### Healthcare Industry Experience

- Deep experience with Medicaid Management Information Systems (MMIS) operations
- Knowledge of state healthcare agency operations and compliance
- Understanding of healthcare provider networks and claims processing
- Experience with Population Health Management and value-based care models
page_texts.23:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#business-transformation]

### Business Transformation

- Experience leading large-scale business transformation initiatives
- Knowledge of digital transformation strategies and implementation
- Understanding of agile and lean transformation methodologies
- Experience with organizational change management
- Experience with Generative AI in business process transformation and strategy development
page_texts.24:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#regulatory--compliance]

### Regulatory & Compliance

- Deep understanding of MITA (Medicaid Information Technology Architecture)
- Experience with state and federal healthcare audit and compliance processes
- Knowledge of CMS regulations and state healthcare program requirements
- Understanding of healthcare quality measures and reporting

---
page_texts.26:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#business-competencies]

### Business Competencies

- **Strategic Thinking**: Ability to align business architecture with organizational strategy
- **Process Design**: Expertise in designing efficient and effective business processes
- **Stakeholder Management**: Skills in working with diverse business and government stakeholders
- **Change Leadership**: Experience leading business transformation and organizational change
page_texts.27:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#analytical-competencies]

### Analytical Competencies

- **Business Analysis**: Advanced business analysis and requirements gathering skills
- **Process Analysis**: Capability to analyze and optimize complex business processes
- **Data Analysis**: Skills in analyzing business data and performance metrics
- **Problem Solving**: Ability to identify and resolve complex business challenges
page_texts.28:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#communication--collaboration]

### Communication & Collaboration

- **Facilitation**: Strong workshop facilitation and meeting management skills
- **Presentation**: Excellent presentation skills for business and technical audiences
- **Documentation**: Ability to create clear and comprehensive business documentation
- **Cross-functional Collaboration**: Skills in working across business and technology teams
page_texts.29:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#healthcare-domain]

### Healthcare Domain

- **Healthcare Operations**: Deep understanding of healthcare business operations
- **Regulatory Knowledge**: Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance requirements
- **Member/Provider Focus**: Understanding of healthcare stakeholder needs and experiences
- **Quality Improvement**: Experience with healthcare quality improvement initiatives

---
page_texts.31:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#business-architecture-delivery]

### Business Architecture Delivery

- Design and implement comprehensive business architectures for healthcare operations
- Ensure business architecture alignment with enterprise architecture standards
- Support successful business transformation and process improvement initiatives
- Maintain business architecture documentation and governance artifacts
page_texts.32:
[resources/job-descriptions/core-positions/business-architect.md#stakeholder-value]

### Stakeholder Value

- Deliver measurable business value through process optimization and transformation
- Ensure business architecture solutions meet stakeholder needs and expectations
- Support business case development and ROI measurement
- Facilitate effective change management and adoption

---
